hints.tr: Yaş için eksi: `-p["age"]` büyükten küçüğe çevirir.
hints.en: A minus for age: `-p["age"]` turns it into largest first.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def sort_people(people):
    ordered = sorted(people, key=lambda p: (-p["age"], p["name"]))
    return [p["name"] for p in ordered]

people = [{"name": "Ada", "age": 36}, {"name": "Alan", "age": 41},
          {"name": "Grace", "age": 36}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 41}]
print(sort_people(people))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def sort_people(people):
    ordered = sorted(people, key=lambda p: (-p["age"], p["name"]))
    return [p["name"] for p in ordered]

people = [{"name": "Ada", "age": 36}, {"name": "Alan", "age": 41},
          {"name": "Grace", "age": 36}, {"name": "Bob", "age": 41}]
print(sort_people(people))
```
